verdict.rationale: This is the standard Microsoft Office setup (Setup32.exe ELEVATED) running a PowerShell check for the Centennial Office package and writing a scratch file to Temp. The 0x1fffff access from the parent and from csrss.exe to the new process is normal process-creation behavior, not injection.
